tasks.name: comments-of-a-playlist
tasks.title: Comments across a whole playlist
tasks.description: Every video in a playlist read in one run, comments merged into a single dataset.

tasks.name: top-comments-with-many-likes
tasks.title: Only the comments with real traction
tasks.description: Set a minimum like count and the one-word replies disappear from the table.

tasks.name: comments-without-replies
tasks.title: Top-level comments only
tasks.description: Turn replies off when you want one row per opinion rather than whole threads.

tasks.name: comments-since-a-date
tasks.title: Only comments left since a date
tasks.description: A date cut-off turns this into monitoring: run it daily and get only what is new.

tasks.name: comments-with-video-details
tasks.title: Comments plus a summary row for each video
tasks.description: Title, views and channel alongside the comments, so the sheet stands on its own.
